high_level_description: The image depicts a man standing on a stage, presenting two large graphics processing units (GPUs). The man is wearing a black leather jacket over a black shirt and dark pants. He has short, graying hair and is wearing glasses. His expression appears focused and professional as he holds the GPUs with both hands. The GPUs are substantial in size, with one being held in each hand. They have a complex design with various components visible, including what appear to be cooling fins and circuitry.
